variants.headline: Looking back: the colony has voted
variants.sub: The colony has held its election to the Colonial Assembly.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: An election to the Colonial Assembly had been held in {colony}.

Our movement regards representation as a duty, not a decoration to be worn until the next campaign. A ballot matters because political convictions should have a route into public decisions. Those who seek support ought to remember the purpose for which that support is sought.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We regard {target} favourably in this assessment. Participation in representative politics deserves a fair hearing, and an election should be an occasion for reasoned judgment rather than reflexive hostility.

variants.headline: Looking back: ballots before the business of government
variants.sub: Voting in an election to the Colonial Assembly has taken place.
variants.body:
Looking back to {first_reported}, this was the news: The colony had held its election to the Colonial Assembly.

Our movement regards representation as a duty, not a decoration to be worn until the next campaign. A ballot matters because political convictions should have a route into public decisions. Those who seek support ought to remember the purpose for which that support is sought.

Time changes the distance from an event, not the need to judge it carefully. Any claim about improvement or deterioration needs more than a recollection of the original news.

We regard {target} favourably in this assessment. Participation in representative politics deserves a fair hearing, and an election should be an occasion for reasoned judgment rather than reflexive hostility.

variants.headline: Looking back: an Assembly election enters the record
variants.sub: An election to the Colonial Assembly has been held in {colony}.
variants.body:
The headline belongs to {first_reported}. Our original account recorded this: Voting in an election to the Colonial Assembly had taken place.

Our movement regards representation as a duty, not a decoration to be worn until the next campaign. A ballot matters because political convictions should have a route into public decisions. Those who seek support ought to remember the purpose for which that support is sought.

What has changed since then should be examined against that original record. What has not changed is the need to distinguish an established event from the hopes or fears attached to it.

We regard {target} favourably in this assessment. Participation in representative politics deserves a fair hearing, and an election should be an occasion for reasoned judgment rather than reflexive hostility.
